messages:
Asha: noticing spike in unclaimed leads from HS dashboard https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/... looks like assignments aren't happening. unclaimed count 512 and growing :grimacing:
Ben: omg okay what's the error? is the assignment webhook failing or the rr worker? :eyes:
Asha: dashboard shows assignment latency > 2m for last 20 minutes, and handoff SLA breach alerts firing
Ben: checked logs briefly — hs-sync-bot posted some errors an hour ago about enrichment timeouts. will pull detailed logs
hs-sync-bot: [automated] 2026-02-12T14:02:10Z Failed to process 6 leads: enrichment-service timeout after 10s. queue=hubspot-inbound-recv
Celine: this looks like the enrichment step is blocking owner claims. quick mitigation: enable fallback owner + smaller claim window so leads don't sit in limbo
Celine: proposed patch (canary):
```
assign_strategy: round_robin
claim_timeout_sec: 120   # from 300 to 120 for canary
fallback_queue: unassigned-leads
enrichment_retry: 2
```
Derek: FYI SF mapping might be related — if HS owner id isn't mapping to SF user we drop claim. i'll audit mapping table
Eve: i'll take owner mapping check now, ping me if you need a hand with SF logs
Ben: also, if we change claim_timeout, we must update the SLA doc and the runbook steps. who can push the patch to dev first?
Celine: i'll roll the canary to 10% traffic in staging then to prod 1 host at a time. monitoring checks: unclaimed_count, assign_errors, sla_breach_rate
Asha: SLA target for handoff is 15m. if fallback triggers we want a manual alert to sales-ops after 30m
Derek: added a quick audit query to check mapping mismatches: `select hs_owner,sf_owner from owner_mapping where sf_owner is null limit 50;`
Eve: found ~18 records with missing SF owner, starting fix now. will run patch and requeue affected leads
Ben: noted — also can we add short-circuit: if enrichment takes >8s, skip enrichment and assign with fallback owner? less ideal but keeps pipeline moving
Celine: agree. will add threshold to enrichment step and short-circuit to fallback owner. will include a flag so we can revert
Asha: thanks — can we get this live in next 45m? sales is calling about missed handoffs
Celine: starting canary deploy now, will post results
hs-sync-bot: [automated] Deploy started canary-assign-patch by celine @ 2026-02-12T14:25:03Z
Celine: canary looks good on host-3, assignment latency dropped to ~18s, unclaimed_count trending down :thumbsup:
Ben: monitoring alert config updated in playbook.md to reflect new claim_timeout and fallback path. pushed to repo
Derek: SF mapping patch applied, requeued 18 leads, seeing successful assignments for 12 so far
Eve: manual follow-up for outstanding 6 leads scheduled with sales-ops
Asha: nice work team. we'll keep watch for 2 hours and then update the handoff playbook with lessons learned
Ben: leaving a TODO to add a Prometheus baseline for enrichment latency and an alert at 50% above baseline
Celine: will create the PR for the short-circuit flag and docs
Eve: thanks all :heart:
Asha: closing loop — postmortem notes to be added to #marketing-docs and an async summary to sales ops
